lines.zh: 身上有一层黑色的东西
lines.en: A black film coats my body.
This arm is longer than the other.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方留着水痕
lines.en: A damp trail follows me.
Every step leans a little.
My fingers stay spread and will not close.
My head stays tilted to one side.
The blackness moves under my skin.
I am a little faster than a common zombie.
I do not detour; I go straight through.
I have crossed the whole clearing.
The blackness has crept onto my shoulder.
I stopped breathing long ago.
My eyes no longer see.
My nails scrape the ground.
Head tilted, as if listening.
A bug crawls over my foot.
My joints turn unnaturally.
I raise my head slowly.
My head tilts toward you.

lines.zh: 你身上的热我感觉得到
lines.en: I can feel the heat on you.
That is not my own voice.

lines.zh: 黑色的东西先替我探路。
lines.en: The blackness scouts ahead for me.
The thing inside me knows you.
My skin is grey.
We are already very close.
Best you do not shift.
I lurch, and still stand.
The blackness pulls back under the skin.
That took half my shoulder.
No sound comes from my throat.
My leg will not obey.
The blood is dark.
The thing inside grows frantic.
One step back, then I return.
This body will not take many blows.
I am still standing there.
That smell is too faint.
That does not suit my teeth.
Is that meat in your hand?
I smell blood.
Hold it a little higher.

lines.zh: 这层共生体，把我撑大了。
lines.en: This symbiote swelled me up.
The thing inside me is crying out.
That is not what I want.
It is no use to you either.
The blow knocks me askew.
I grab you at once.
My nails rake your armor.
Pushing only makes me wilder.
The blackness flinches back.
I press against you again.
It has surprising strength.

lines.zh: 靠这么近，是来喂我的吗？
lines.en: This close, are you here to feed me?

lines.zh: 我记不起活着的时候了
lines.en: I cannot recall being alive.
This body has no need of that.

lines.zh: 我连自己的名字都忘了
lines.en: I have forgotten my own name.

lines.zh: 里面的东西只想要吃的
lines.en: The thing inside wants only food.
Your warmth unsettles me.

lines.zh: 我不靠近你，你也别靠近
lines.en: I keep away; you do the same.

lines.zh: 这具身体已经不是我的
lines.en: This body is not mine anymore.
I am thinking of someone long ago.
Do not speak to me.
I will keep walking.
My hands cannot grasp.
I press it into the mud.
There is no smell at all.
I grab; it slips away.
My nails pierce it.
I care nothing for these.
I want only meat.
I pinch it between both hands.
Carrying it off is useless.
I have heard you.
My hand moved first.
You have backed to the wall.
I am much faster than a common zombie.
The thing inside me is hungry.
I have your direction.
The smell of your blood is plain.

lines.zh: 我拖着这条腿，也够得到。
lines.en: Even dragging this leg, I can reach you.
You are a few steps away.
You have already raised a hand.
I have raised mine too.
This will not take long.
I am not afraid of pain.
The thing inside pushes me on.
You circle once; so do I.
I know the marks on the ground.
Stop, and I am there.
I am behind you.
You turn; I lag half a beat.
My arm keeps twitching.
You cannot hear me, but I am here.
I hit a tree and did not stop.
Your sweat reaches me.
A patch of dark lies between us.
I will keep coming toward you.
I do not breathe, so I do not tire.
My hand reaches out.
The blackness climbs onto your shadow first.
That one came with nails.
I bite into your shoulder.
The shove slams you into the wall.
My strength is great.
That tore one open.
The blackness reaches out.
Your skin is broken.
I drag my leg closer to you.
That blow landed badly.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我里面的东西笑。
lines.en: You step back, and the thing inside laughs.
I take one more step in.
My hand is still raised.
It is over.

lines.zh: 我从阴影里走出来，这具身体不是我的了。
lines.en: I step out of the shadow; this body is no longer mine.
There is something new on me.
This body is no longer mine.
I tilted my head and listened.
The blackness slowly tightens.
My feet are in the mud.
There is a sound ahead.
I tilt my head that way.
I take one step forward.
There is still soil on me.
I raise my head and sniff.
The fire catches and the black hide tightens.
The blast tears half of me away.
Something is pinned in my chest.

lines.zh: 那力量让我里面的东西乱动
lines.en: That force makes the thing inside thrash.
Hunger makes me more restless.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整个人抽了一下
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my whole body jerks.
No heat here, and no blood.
